seo.title: About — areyoustillreading
seo.description: About the site and the person writing it: measured, first-person notes on LLM engineering and the systems underneath.

about.headline: The name is *a question I ask myself* while editing.

body.p1: I'm Shivam — I work on machine-learning systems, and I write here about LLM engineering and the unglamorous infrastructure underneath it. The day job is making inference fast and reliable; the evenings are for writing down the parts that were harder than the papers implied.
body.p2: This site exists because the good stuff kept getting lost. A profiling session would turn up something genuinely surprising — a cache policy that behaved backwards under load, a retrieval metric that flattered a broken system — and it would end up in a Slack thread, then nowhere. Writing it down properly forces the second question: *do I actually understand this, or did I just get it working?* Usually the answer is uncomfortable, and the essay gets better.
body.p3: Everything here is first-person and measured. If I claim a number, I ran it; if I'm guessing, I say so. I don't cover launches, I don't do hot takes, and I try very hard not to write anything that could have been a tweet.
body.quote: Most of what I know I learned by being wrong in public, slowly.
body.p4: Most of the writing is free. A few of the longer essays sit behind a one-time unlock — a single payment for that piece, set per essay, not a subscription and nothing recurring. It's less a growth strategy than a filter: paying a little usually means you intend to finish, which is the only readership metric I care about.
body.p5: If something here is wrong, tell me. Corrections get a note at the bottom of the piece with your name on it, unless you'd rather they didn't.

portrait.caption: A photo goes here — something plain and unstaged. Same warm paper tone as the rest of the site, nothing glossy.

colophon.heading: Colophon
colophon.typeBody: Headings in Source Serif 4, body in Charis SIL — a descendant of Bitstream Charter — with interface text in the system sans. Both serifs are self-hosted, so the site reads the same on every platform.
colophon.builtBody: Astro, built to static HTML and deployed on Cloudflare Pages on every push. Written in plain Markdown, with diagrams and plots rendered from source at build time.
